LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_Basin.label: laundry basin
LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_Basin.description: Build a proper laundry basin with a scrubbing board, so garments can be soaked and washed faster than in a hand tub.
LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_Soap.label: soap making
LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_Soap.description: Render wood ash and cloth scraps into bars of soap. Soap lifts grease out of fabric, so a washed garment comes out completely clean instead of merely less dirty.
LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_Washer.label: washing machine
LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_Washer.description: An electric drum washer that scrubs a garment on its own, cycle after cycle, as long as it has power, water and soap. Requires electricity.
LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_UltraSonic.label: ultrasonic cleaning
LanguageData.ClothingHygiene_UltraSonic.description: Sonic agitation strips dirt out of fabric without scrubbing. An ultrasonic washer uses half the water and half the soap, and finishes each load in half the time.
